text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm planning an atomic split of the large 'guides' tree into platform/guides and product/guides. This moves ~120 MD files, updates frontmatter, and requires redirects. Need reviewers, a merge sequencing plan, and to keep docs-preview stable.
ryan: +1. We should shard by feature-area instead of file count — getting-started, auth, integrations, sdk, examples. Smaller PRs are easier to preview.
lee: CI/link-checker usually surfaces broken anchors when we move files. We need an anchor-redirect map or add anchor fragments to redirects.
sam: Do we have an agreed redirect mechanism? Netlify/_redirects vs nginx rules vs CDN? For hosted customers we need canonical permanent redirects.
maya: I'll prepare redirect rules in redirects/_redirects format and a netlify.toml snippet so both hosted and private deployments can copy the rules. Proposed PR shards: shard-1 (getting-started + auth), shard-2 (integrations + sdk), shard-3 (examples + api).
ryan: Assign me reviewer on shard-1 and shard-3. @lee please take anchor safety review on shard-1.
lee: ack. I'll run linkinator against the preview URL for each shard. Please add a CHANGELOG block in each PR describing moved slugs and old->new paths.
ci-bot: ci/docs-preview — shard-1 build failed: 3 broken anchors detected. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/12345 (auth/oauth2.md -> missing #token-flow anchor, getting-started/quickstart.md -> #install-step mismatch)
maya: On it — I'll push a patch to shard-1 with an anchor alias file and a small redirects map. Also adding explicit frontmatter redirects where needed.
maya: Quick question: do we merge shards sequentially (one-at-a-time) or all at once? Sequential reduces blast radius but slows rollout. Thoughts?
sam: Sequential is safer. Merge shard-1, wait for docs-canary deploy + 10m smoke tests, then shard-2 + shard-3. If any preview fails, roll back next merges.
ryan: Also ping SDK owners — some code samples reference absolute paths. @alex @jord — confirm snippets won't break. I'll tag them in the PR descriptions.
alex: Thanks — our SDK snippets reference /sdk/python/quickstart.md. We'll vendor a copy in the SDK repo and update snippet CI to fetch from the new path. I can make a quick PR to SDK CI today.
maya: Plan update: I'll open shard PRs now and include in each PR description: moved slugs list, redirect entries (redirects/_redirects), a small link-checker report, and a reviewer checklist. I'll also create a docs-canary branch that merges shard-1 once approved.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: docs-canary -> staging at 2024-06-15T03:00Z (auto-trigger in ~5h).
lee: One more ask — add a tiny e2e smoke in docs-e2e that fetches 5 representative moved URLs and asserts 200 + anchor fragment present. That'll catch anchor redirect regressions.
maya: :thumbsup: I'll add the smoke test PR after shard-1 lands. If everyone is aligned, I'll start opening PRs for shard-1 now and tag reviewers.
ryan: go for it.
maya: Thanks — I'll post the shard-1 PR link here once opened and follow up with the CI fix patches.
